newsitem.title: USA: Calif. pension fund names deputy general counsel.
newsitem.headline: Calif. pension fund names deputy general counsel.

text.p: The California Public Employees' Retirement System (CalPERS) on Wednesday announced the appointment of Anne Stausboll as the retirement system's deputy general counsel.

She will also serve as legal counsel to the CalPERS board benefits and program administration committee, in-house legal counsel for the CalPERS alternative investment management program and lead CalPERS counsel for conflict of interest and ethics issues, CalPERS said.
Stausboll joined the CalPERS legal staff in 1993 after six years as a staff attorney for the California State Employees' Association.

CalPERS is the nation's largest pension fund with assets totaling more than $108 billion. It administers retirement and health benefits for more than one million California public employees, retirees and their families.
